headline: A 10-Year Treasury Bond Now Pays More Than 118 Of America's Biggest Companies
summary: Only 3.85% of S&P 500 stocks now yield more than the 10-year Treasury, the lowest since May 2007. Benzinga found 118 mega-caps that pay less.

headline: Broadcom’s AI Competition Fears Look Overblown: Analyst
summary: JPMorgan reiterates Overweight on Broadcom (AVGO), citing intact Google TPU roadmap, surging network demand, and projected $56B+ AI revenue.

headline: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia Partner Says Tesla, Waymo Are Growing the Physical AI Market — Not Competing With It
summary: Ouster CEO Angus Pacala says Tesla and Waymo are accelerating Physical AI adoption rather than competing with the lidar maker.
